scope: Final minimal research dashboard redesign browser confirmation

environment.inference: Deterministic fixture completion only; outbound inference blocked

text_enlargement.method: Doubled computed font sizes of rendered HTML elements after snapshot; stronger than changing root rem size for px-sized typography
text_enlargement.controls: Source select grows to47px; multiline input scrolls internally; no usage/disclosure overlap observed

manual.settled_capture_method: After each tab selection wait650ms, blur active element, instant scrollTo0, wait650ms; viewport capture only. Each final normal capture recorded scrollY0/headerY0/headerHeight65.

contrast.method: WCAG relative luminance using actual computed text and surface colors; alpha backgrounds composited over canvas

limitations: Deterministic browser responses verify plumbing and presentation, not model answer quality.
Source safety checks use the frozen m0-real-metformin workspace; browser workspace-list response narrowed to expose that fixture only, without changing underlying evidence.
Text-only enlargement is a browser stress test, not platform assistive-technology certification.
Early full-page screenshots contain sticky-header/scroll timing artifacts; final settled viewport screenshots are authoritative for visual review.
